result.summary: The interface exhibits three distinct polish issues related to content quality and data accuracy.

issues.description: Food listings use generic vector illustrations instead of high-quality photography.
issues.suggestion: Implement actual food images to improve visual appeal.

issues.description: A '-100%' discount badge is visible, suggesting a data or logic error.
issues.suggestion: Validate promo data to ensure accurate discount values.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the horizontal carousel are truncated prematurely.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text containers to allow for full title visibility.
